name: BlockSparseAttnFwd

q.description: 查询张量 (varlen 打包), shape (total_q, H, D); float16/bfloat16

k.description: 键张量, shape (total_k, HK, D), H % HK == 0 (MHA/GQA/MQA); 与 q 同 dtype

v.description: 值张量, shape (total_k, HK, D); 与 q 同 dtype

softmax_scale.description: softmax 缩放 (乘在 q 上), float 标量

exact_streaming.description: streaming 头是否用 token 粒度精确掩码 (仅因果), bool

q_lens.description: 各序列 q 长度, int 列表, sum == total_q

k_lens.description: 各序列 k 长度, int 列表, sum == total_k

sparsity.description: blocksparse 头块稀疏度 (保留比例), float ∈ [0,1]

sink.description: streaming 头 sink 块数 (exact 时为 token 数), int

local.description: streaming 头 local 块数 (exact 时为 token 数), int

out.description: 注意力输出, shape (total_q, H, D), 与 q 同 dtype

reference:
import torch

BLOCK = 128


def _ceil_div(x, y):
    return (x + y - 1) // y


def _gen_base_blockmask(B, nblk, nrow, ncol, sparsity, causal):
    bm = torch.zeros(B, nblk, nrow, ncol, dtype=torch.bool)
    for b in range(B):
        for h in range(nblk):
            s = sparsity
            if s != 0.0 and s != 1.0:
                for i in range(nrow):
                    idx = nrow - i - 1
                    avail = max(0, ncol - i) if causal else ncol
                    num_one = max(1, int(s * avail))
                    bm[b, h, idx, torch.randperm(avail)[:num_one]] = True
            elif s == 1.0:
                bm[b, h] = True
    return bm


def _streaming_keep_mask(sq, sk, sink, local, causal, device):
    nrow, ncol = _ceil_div(sq, BLOCK), _ceil_div(sk, BLOCK)
    keep = torch.zeros(nrow, ncol, dtype=torch.bool, device=device)
    start = max((sq - sk) // BLOCK, 0) if causal else 0
    for i in range(start, nrow):
        if causal:
            mr = _ceil_div(max(sk - sq, 0), BLOCK) + 1 + (i - start)
        else:
            mr = ncol
        keep[i, max(mr - local, 0):min(mr, ncol)] = True
        keep[i, :sink] = True
    keep = keep.repeat_interleave(BLOCK, 0).repeat_interleave(BLOCK, 1)
    return keep[:sq, :sk]


def _exact_streaming_keep_mask(sq, sk, sink, local, device):
    row = torch.arange(sq, device=device).unsqueeze(1)
    col = torch.arange(sk, device=device).unsqueeze(0)
    blocked = torch.logical_or(
        col > torch.minimum(row + sk - sq, torch.full_like(col, sk)),
        torch.logical_and(col < row + sk - sq - (local - 1), col >= sink))
    return ~blocked


def run(q, k, v, softmax_scale, is_causal, exact_streaming,
        q_lens, k_lens, sparsity, sink, local):
    device = q.device
    total_q, H, D = q.shape
    total_k, HK, _ = k.shape
    assert k.shape == v.shape and k.shape[2] == D
    assert H % HK == 0
    assert q.dtype == k.dtype == v.dtype
    B = len(q_lens)
    assert len(k_lens) == B
    assert sum(q_lens) == total_q and sum(k_lens) == total_k

    torch.manual_seed(3407)
    cu_seqlens_q = torch.tensor(
        [0] + list(torch.tensor(q_lens).cumsum(0)), dtype=torch.int32, device=device)
    cu_seqlens_k = torch.tensor(
        [0] + list(torch.tensor(k_lens).cumsum(0)), dtype=torch.int32, device=device)
    ns, nb = H // 3, H // 3
    head_mask_type = torch.tensor([0] * (H - ns - nb) + [1] * nb + [-1] * ns,
                                  dtype=torch.int32, device=device)
    streaming_info = torch.tensor([sink, local] * H, dtype=torch.int32, device=device)
    max_q, max_k = max(q_lens), max(k_lens)
    nrow = _ceil_div(max_q, BLOCK)
    ncol = _ceil_div(max_k, BLOCK)
    base_blockmask = _gen_base_blockmask(B, nb, nrow, ncol,
                                         sparsity, is_causal).to(device)
    if exact_streaming:
        assert is_causal

    dtype = q.dtype
    G = H // HK
    scale = softmax_scale if softmax_scale is not None else D ** -0.5
    out = torch.zeros_like(q, dtype=torch.float32)

    blk_rank = 0
    blk_ranks = []
    for h in range(H):
        blk_ranks.append(blk_rank)
        if int(head_mask_type[h]) == 1:
            blk_rank += 1

    for b in range(B):
        qs, qe = int(cu_seqlens_q[b]), int(cu_seqlens_q[b + 1])
        ks, ke = int(cu_seqlens_k[b]), int(cu_seqlens_k[b + 1])
        sq, sk = qe - qs, ke - ks
        q_b = q[qs:qe].float()
        k_b = k[ks:ke].float().repeat_interleave(G, dim=1)
        v_b = v[ks:ke].float().repeat_interleave(G, dim=1)

        scores = torch.einsum('t h d, s h d -> h t s',
                              q_b * scale, k_b)
        keeps = []
        for h in range(H):
            t = int(head_mask_type[h])
            if t == 0:
                keep = None
            elif t == 1:
                keep = base_blockmask[b, blk_ranks[h]] \
                    .repeat_interleave(BLOCK, 0).repeat_interleave(BLOCK, 1)[:sq, :sk]
            else:
                snk, lcl = int(streaming_info[2 * h]), int(streaming_info[2 * h + 1])
                if exact_streaming:
                    keep = _exact_streaming_keep_mask(sq, sk, snk, lcl, device)
                else:
                    keep = _streaming_keep_mask(sq, sk, snk, lcl, is_causal, device)
            if is_causal:
                row = torch.arange(sq, device=device).unsqueeze(1)
                col = torch.arange(sk, device=device).unsqueeze(0)
                causal_keep = col <= row + (sk - sq)
                keep = causal_keep if keep is None else (keep & causal_keep)
            keeps.append(keep)

        for h in range(H):
            if keeps[h] is not None:
                scores[h].masked_fill_(~keeps[h], float('-inf'))
        attn = torch.softmax(scores, dim=-1)
        for h in range(H):
            if keeps[h] is not None:
                attn[h].masked_fill_(~keeps[h], 0.0)
        out[qs:qe] = torch.einsum('h t s, s h d -> t h d', attn, v_b)
    return out.to(dtype)
description:
block_sparse_attn_func 前向 —— MIT Han Lab Block-Sparse-Attention (varlen 打包布局的块稀疏注意力) golden reference。对标 mit-han-lab/Block-Sparse-Attention (基于 FlashAttention 2.4.2) block_sparse_attn/block_sparse_attn_interface.py 的 block_sparse_attn_func, 语义依据官方单测 block_sparse_tests/fwd_bwd/test_correctness/utils.py 的 attention_blocksparse_ref 及掩码生成器 generate_base_sparsity_mask / generate_streaming_mask / construct_exact_streaming_mask。
数学语义 (varlen 打包, 逐序列、逐头; GQA 组内 k/v 沿头维 repeat_interleave(G) 复用):
  对序列 b、头 h 的 token 级保留掩码 keep ∈ {0,1}^{sq×sk}:
    dense (head_mask_type=0): 全 1
    blocksparse (=1): base_blockmask[b, r] 按 128×128 展开后裁到 [sq, sk], r 为该头在 blocksparse 头中的序号
    streaming (=-1, 块粒度, exact_streaming=False): 行块 i 保留前 sink 个列块与对角前 local 个列块
    streaming (=-1, token 粒度, exact_streaming=True, 仅因果): keep = (col <= min(row+sk-sq, sk)) & ~((col < row+sk-sq-(local-1)) & (col >= sink))
    causal 时以上掩码再与因果掩码取交 (底右对齐)
  注意力 (fp32): scores = (q·scale) @ k^T; scores[masked] = -inf; attn = softmax(scores); attn[masked] = 0 (全掩码行 NaN 置 0, 输出定义为 0); o = attn @ v 回铸 q.dtype
派生输入过程 (reference 与 solution 必须按此完全相同的过程从标量配置派生, run() 内以 torch.manual_seed(3407) 固定随机性):
    cu_seqlens_q = [0] + cumsum(q_lens), cu_seqlens_k = [0] + cumsum(k_lens) (int32)
    head_mask_type = [0]*(H-2*(H//3)) + [1]*(H//3) + [-1]*(H//3) (int32, 1/3 streaming + 1/3 blocksparse + 其余 dense)
    streaming_info = [sink, local] * H (int32)
    base_blockmask [B, H//3, ceil(max_q/128), ceil(max_k/128)] bool, 逐 batch/头/行块生成: sparsity∉{0,1} 时第 i 行块 (自底向上) 在可用列块 (causal 时 ncol-i 个, 否则 ncol 个) 中随机保留 max(1, int(sparsity*avail)) 个 (torch.randperm); sparsity==1 全保留; sparsity==0 全掩码
